metrics.name: Outstanding patient A/R (current)
metrics.internal_reason: Snapshot balance convention (HFMA defines A/R days, not this sum); Agere convention stated in full.
metrics.summary: Sum of positive balance_cents on the latest snapshot (max event_time, record_id tiebreak) of each patient billing account (account_id). Patient credits are not netted; payer-pending amounts (provider_pending_cents) are not patient A/R. Dollars.

checks.why: open A/R sums positive balances only; credit balances are not netted against what patients owe
payer-pending amounts are not patient A/R

metrics.sql_template: SELECT sum(balance_cents) / 100.0 AS patient_ar_usd FROM (SELECT json_extract(payload,'$.balance_cents') AS balance_cents, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY json_extract(payload,'$.account_id') ORDER BY json_extract(payload,'$.event_time') DESC, record_id DESC) AS rn FROM record WHERE stream = 'patient_billing_accounts') WHERE rn = 1 AND balance_cents > 0

metrics.name: Billed, allowed and paid by service type (current claim state)
metrics.internal_reason: Revenue-cycle reporting convention over the received adjudication chain; no published standard.
metrics.summary: Medical claims (claim_id) with service_date in the period and at least one adjudication: the latest medical_claims record per claim by event_time (record_id tiebreak) is the current state. Billed = its billed_cents; allowed/paid = its allowed_cents/payer_paid_cents, except denied claims and claims whose latest record is a reversal awaiting replacement count 0 allowed and 0 paid. Grouped by service_code; dollars.

population.summary: Adjudicated medical claims with service_date in the period.

numerator.summary: Billed, allowed and paid from each claim's current adjudication.

checks.why: a claim whose current state is a reversal awaiting replacement (or a denial) has 0 allowed and 0 paid; summing the latest record's amounts without the status rule inflates allowed

metrics.sql_template: SELECT sc AS service_code, count(*) AS claims, sum(b) / 100.0 AS billed, sum(CASE WHEN st IN ('reversed','denied') THEN 0 ELSE al END) / 100.0 AS allowed, sum(CASE WHEN st IN ('reversed','denied') THEN 0 ELSE pd END) / 100.0 AS paid FROM (SELECT json_extract(payload,'$.service_code') AS sc, json_extract(payload,'$.service_date') AS sd, json_extract(payload,'$.status') AS st, json_extract(payload,'$.billed_cents') AS b, json_extract(payload,'$.allowed_cents') AS al, json_extract(payload,'$.payer_paid_cents') AS pd, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY json_extract(payload,'$.claim_id') ORDER BY json_extract(payload,'$.event_time') DESC, record_id DESC) AS rn FROM record WHERE stream = 'medical_claims' AND json_extract(payload,'$.claim_id') IS NOT NULL) WHERE rn = 1 AND sd BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}' GROUP BY sc ORDER BY sc

metrics.name: Net payer paid on medical claims (after reversals)
metrics.internal_reason: Revenue-cycle convention over the adjudication chain (net = payments minus takebacks across every adjudication record).
metrics.summary: Sum over medical claims (our provider claims plus payer-feed claims that are not the payer's copy of one of them; claim.claim_source) with service_date in the period of payer-paid deltas across EVERY adjudication record (original payments, reversals, voids, recoupments, replacement payments; denials 0) = claim.net_payer_paid_cents. Dollars.

population.summary: Medical claims (claim_id) with service_date in the period.

numerator.summary: Net payer paid across all adjudication versions.

metrics.sql_template: SELECT sum(net_payer_paid_cents) / 100.0 AS net_payer_paid_usd FROM claim WHERE service_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'

adjudicated.summary: Net payer paid (every adjudication delta; reversals net out) on medical claims first adjudicated in the period. Dollars.
adjudicated.sql_template: SELECT sum(net_payer_paid_cents) / 100.0 AS net_payer_paid_usd FROM claim WHERE first_adjudication_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'

first_paid.summary: Net payer paid on medical claims whose first PAID adjudication falls in the period. Dollars.
first_paid.sql_template: SELECT sum(c.net_payer_paid_cents) / 100.0 AS net_payer_paid_usd FROM claim c WHERE c.first_paid_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'

metrics.name: Contractual write-offs (net)
metrics.internal_reason: Contractual adjustment (CARC group CO, contractual) netted across the adjudication chain; Agere convention.
metrics.summary: Sum of financial_deltas_cents.contractual across ALL adjudication records of medical claims with service_date in the period (reversal records carry negative contractual amounts and net out). Patient responsibility and denials are not contractual adjustments. Dollars.

population.summary: Medical claims (claim_id) with service_date in the period.

numerator.summary: Net contractual adjustment across every adjudication version.

metrics.sql_template: SELECT sum(json_extract(payload,'$.financial_deltas_cents.contractual')) / 100.0 AS contractual_usd FROM record WHERE stream = 'medical_claims' AND json_extract(payload,'$.claim_id') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract(payload,'$.service_date') BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'

metrics.name: Payer cash posted, net of take-backs, by payer
metrics.internal_reason: Cash-posting convention: provider-recorded EFT allocations, recoupments netted; payer attributed from the claim.
metrics.summary: payer_cash_allocations with event_date (posting date) in the period, negative allocations (recoupments) netted in. Allocations do not name the payer: payer = the medical claim's payer organization (claim.payer). Columns: payer, allocations, net_cash_dollars.

checks.why: allocations do not carry the payer; attribute each allocation to the payer on its medical claim
payer comes from the medical claim; joining remittance-advice versions fans out allocations

metrics.sql_template: SELECT c.payer AS payer, count(*) AS allocations, sum(json_extract(r.payload,'$.allocated_cents')) / 100.0 AS net_cash_dollars FROM record r JOIN claim c ON c.claim_id = json_extract(r.payload,'$.claim_id') WHERE r.stream = 'payer_cash_allocations' AND r.event_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}' GROUP BY c.payer ORDER BY c.payer

metrics.name: First-pass denial rate
metrics.internal_reason: HFMA MAP keys name initial denial rate; Agere computes it per claim from the first adjudication by arrival order.
metrics.summary: Percent of medical claims with service_date in the period whose first adjudication (claim.first_status) was a denial.

population.summary: Medical claims with service_date in the period.

metrics.sql_template: SELECT 100.0 * sum(first_status = 'denied') / count(*) AS first_pass_denial_rate FROM claim WHERE service_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'

billed_dollars_adjudicated.summary: Percent of billed dollars (billed_cents) on medical claims first adjudicated in the period that belong to claims whose first adjudication (claim.first_status) was a denial.
billed_dollars_adjudicated.sql_template: SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN first_status = 'denied' THEN billed_cents ELSE 0 END) / sum(billed_cents) AS first_pass_denied_billed_pct FROM claim WHERE first_adjudication_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'

adjudicated.summary: Percent of medical claims first adjudicated in the period whose first adjudication (claim.first_status) was a denial.
adjudicated.sql_template: SELECT 100.0 * sum(first_status = 'denied') / count(*) AS first_pass_denial_rate FROM claim WHERE first_adjudication_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'

billed_dollars.summary: Percent of billed dollars (billed_cents) on medical claims with service_date in the period that belong to claims whose first adjudication was a denial.
billed_dollars.sql_template: SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN first_status = 'denied' THEN billed_cents ELSE 0 END) / sum(billed_cents) AS first_pass_denied_billed_pct FROM claim WHERE service_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'

metrics.name: Claim lag (date of service to first submission)
metrics.internal_reason: Revenue-cycle timing convention: business clocks (service date, submission date), never warehouse arrival dates.
metrics.summary: Mean days from service_date to first_submitted_date for medical claims with service_date in the period.

all: lag|days? from|how many days|how long|time to

metrics.sql_template: SELECT avg(julianday(first_submitted_date) - julianday(service_date)) AS avg_claim_lag_days FROM claim WHERE first_submitted_date IS NOT NULL AND service_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'

metrics.name: Days from date of service to first payer cash
metrics.internal_reason: Revenue-cycle timing convention on business clocks.
metrics.summary: Mean (or median when asked) days from service_date to first_payer_cash_date for medical claims with service_date in the period that have received payer cash.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT avg(julianday(first_payer_cash_date) - julianday(service_date)) AS avg_days_to_cash FROM claim WHERE first_payer_cash_date IS NOT NULL AND service_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'

first_paid.summary: Mean days from service_date to the claim's first PAID adjudication (the payer's payment decision), for medical claims whose first paid adjudication date falls in the period. 'First paid in' anchors on the paid adjudication date, not the cash date (say 'cash received' for the cash clock).
first_paid.sql_template: SELECT avg(julianday(c.first_paid_date) - julianday(c.service_date)) AS avg_days_to_first_paid FROM claim c WHERE c.first_paid_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'

cash_received.summary: Mean days from service_date to first_payer_cash_date for medical claims whose first payer cash posted in the period.
cash_received.sql_template: SELECT avg(julianday(first_payer_cash_date) - julianday(service_date)) AS avg_days_to_cash FROM claim WHERE first_payer_cash_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'

metrics.name: Days from date of service to first payer adjudication
metrics.internal_reason: Revenue-cycle timing convention on business clocks.
metrics.summary: Mean days from service_date to first_adjudication_date for medical claims with service_date in the period.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT avg(julianday(first_adjudication_date) - julianday(service_date)) AS avg_days_to_adjudication FROM claim WHERE first_adjudication_date IS NOT NULL AND service_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'

adjudicated.summary: Mean days from service_date to first_adjudication_date for medical claims first adjudicated in the period.
adjudicated.sql_template: SELECT avg(julianday(first_adjudication_date) - julianday(service_date)) AS avg_days_to_adjudication FROM claim WHERE first_adjudication_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'

metrics.name: Allowed cost per member per month (PMPM)
metrics.summary: Allowed dollars on medical claims with service_date in the period (current adjudication; reversed/denied = 0) divided by member-months (roster headcount x months in period; no enrollment spans received).

population.summary: Roster patients; member-months approximated from headcount.

denominator.summary: Roster headcount x months in the period.

numerator.summary: Allowed dollars on current claim adjudications.

metrics.sql_template: SELECT (SELECT sum(CASE WHEN final_status IN ('reversed','denied') THEN 0 ELSE allowed_cents END) FROM claim WHERE service_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}') / 100.0 / ((SELECT count(*) FROM patient) * ((julianday('{period_end}') - julianday('{period_start}') + 1) / 30.4375)) AS allowed_pmpm
metrics.internal_reason: Agere PMPM convention: allowed dollars on current adjudications over roster member-months (no enrollment spans received); ACO REACH/MSSP expenditure PMPM uses enrollment months.

metrics.name: Medical claims reversed by the payer
metrics.internal_reason: Revenue-cycle convention over the adjudication chain: a reversal is an adjudication record with status reversed (the payer takes back a payment, usually before reprocessing the claim).
metrics.summary: Distinct medical claims (claim_id; our provider claims and payer-feed claims, claim_adjudication) with at least one payer reversal adjudication (status 'reversed') whose event date falls in the period - anchored on the reversal event date, not the service date. Provider voids/replacements and recoupments are not payer reversals.

population.summary: Medical claims with a reversal adjudication in the period.

numerator.summary: Distinct claim_ids with a reversal adjudication record dated in the period.

service_date.summary: Distinct medical claims with service_date in the period that have any reversal adjudication record.
service_date.sql_template: SELECT count(*) AS claims_reversed FROM claim WHERE service_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}' AND claim_id IN (SELECT claim_id FROM claim_adjudication WHERE status = 'reversed')

metrics.sql_template: SELECT count(DISTINCT claim_id) AS claims_reversed FROM claim_adjudication WHERE status = 'reversed' AND event_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'
